description: Basic evaluation suite for chart alt-text descriptions quality assessment

metrics.name: structure_completeness
metrics.description: Check if all mandatory sections are present (Overview, Structure, Patterns, Details)

metrics.name: readability_score
metrics.description: Average of Flesch Reading Ease and Gunning Fog index

metrics.name: factual_accuracy
metrics.description: Percentage of factual claims that are supported by ground truth

metrics.name: no_visual_references
metrics.description: Check for prohibited visual references like 'as seen', 'on the left', etc.
